subject: polity
title: Power Sharing
summary: Distribution of power among different organs, levels, and social groups of government to ensure stability and democracy.
canonical_facts: Prudential reason: reduces social conflict and guarantees political stability.
Moral reason: power sharing is the very spirit of legitimate democracy.
Horizontal division exists between Legislature, Executive, and Judiciary.

subject: polity
title: Federalism
summary: System of government where sovereign power is divided between a central authority and constituent state units.
canonical_facts: Requires two or more tiers of government with independent constitutional jurisdictions.
73rd and 74th Amendments established local self-government (Panchayati Raj and Municipalities).
India is described in Article 1 as a Union of States.
